description: Ministry of Defence - Name List of the Air Force Personnel approved to award the Videsha Sewa Padakkama (From SVC No. 01877 to 15740)
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the award of the Videsha Sewa Padakkama (Foreign Service Medal) to Air Force personnel. This falls under public service recognition and awards, which is categorized under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with honors and recognition within the public sector/armed forces, rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments with portfolios, or any of the other specialized categories.
